messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: INLA  treats numeric variables as factors
parts:
On Fri, 2015-09-04 at 04:40 -0700, paul mwaniki wrote:


sorry for late reponse. the problem is that variable 'x' is 'chr',
which is then interpreted as factor. just make it numeric and you're
fine.

PS: I get a lot of overflow running it, so something goes to infinity
internally...

H



#-- Define the formula --#
formula<-hookworm~-1+avg_hworm_epg+ latrine + x+f(field,model=spde)
dat=inla.stack.data(stack,spde=spde)
dat$x = as.numeric(dat$x)

mod<-inla(formula,data=dat,family="binomial",
control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stack),compute=T),
control.fixed=list(expand.factor.strategy="inla"),
verbose=TRUE)
